summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration_31 i18n items, run on the mobile web preview at 375x667 with the autoT cache cleared before each check. ALL 7 REQUESTED ITEMS ARE FIXED. (1) Driver: the status reads Online/Offline in en/de/zh/he with no reload. The Offline toggle works and the text changes right away in de. The empty-list texts for active/available/history are translated in ar/en/de/zh, and the History tab reads History / Verlauf / 历史记录. (2) Warranties: past-dated warranties now show Expired / Abgelaufen / 已过期 / منتهي on the first paint. 'N days left' is translated. (3) driver, warranties, chamber, competition/[id], addresses, draw, track-order and LoyaltyRedeemPicker all call useT(). (4) /group-buys and /points show no raw keys in ar/en/de/zh/he. Every t('x.y') key without a fallback (186 in total) exists in all 20 dictionaries. Points tier (Silver/Silber/白银会员/כסף) and the history reason (Order #/Bestellung #/订单 #) translate. (5) Dictionary entries are corrected: Preset Role, Delete Role, Missing Information, Preset badge (Preset/Voreingestellt/预设), Orders, Support '📍 Store Address' (de Filialadresse, zh 门店地址), and 'ساري' = Active. (6) My Returns in en/de/zh is LTR (text-align start/ltr, back chevron-back, card chevron-forward). (7) Regression: 0 pageerrors and no blank pages across about 52 customer/merchant/driver pages in zh/he/ar/de, the 19 en customer routes and the 26 en merchant routes. NEW untranslated or wrong UI strings found by an Arabic-residue scan of en/de pages: hardcoded English in chamber.tsx and draw.tsx (also shown in Arabic), Arabic status maps in track-order, merchant bookings, service-bookings, delivery-settings and loyalty-history, hardcoded English in support-settings, carrier names always Arabic in checkout, RTL-hardcoded create-return in LTR languages, and wrong dictionary entries ('سحب' = withdrawal, 'ربحت' = won). No deprecated Expo packages were found (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner and expo-background-fetch are absent).

critical_code_review_comments: Recurring pattern: module-level Arabic label maps (STATUS_AR, STATUSES, TAB_LABELS, SOURCE_LABEL, FIELDS) are rendered without tSync. Consider a small helper, e.g. tLabel(map[key]), and grep for `Record<string, string> = {` with Arabic values.
Several Alert.alert calls still use hardcoded English ('Error', 'Permission', ...) in driver, chamber and draw.

Not covered: alerts are a no-op on react-native-web, so alert texts were verified in code only. Group-buy cards (gb.activated/joined/participants, comp.daysLeft) could not be viewed because there are no active group buys; the keys were verified in all 20 dictionaries.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 7 requested retest items pass; 14 new UI translation bugs found on other screens

seed_data_creation: None. The driver was toggled Offline during testing and then set back to online=true via POST /api/driver/online.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via fetch /api/auth/login, set localStorage token/user/app_lang, then page.goto. Clear '@zenrex_autot_cache_v2' to test on-demand translation. Useful technique: regex-scan body text for Arabic runs on en/de pages to find untranslated UI strings, then exclude DB content (names, product/competition titles, branches, posts, notifications, wallet descriptions). Going Online in the driver toggle needs geolocation (headless denies it), so it only works one way in tests.
